description: Answers: how far does this news article hold up? Give the link. Orb Studio loads the page (honest User-Agent, no login, captcha or paywall bypass, robots.txt respected), separates facts from opinions, finds the original source if the article retells another outlet, checks numbers and dates against independent sources found by web search (Claude with web search) and flags old news presented as new. Returns: confirmed (each with source links), exaggerated (wording goes beyond the sources), opinions (who said it), unverified ('not verified' = no independent source found, not 'false'), missing (what the article does not give), original_source, freshness (earlier date and source if the event already happened), and a verdict counted by code from those lists. Quotes are verified against the page text and links against real search results; nothing is invented. Costs real checking effort: 6 new checks per hour per address, results cached 24 hours. For a headline without a link use check_claim (free word rules) or check_headline (outlet count).
